submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on the first token of an optional circumstantial extension -- a causal/temporal/manner/locative adjunct, source preposition, approximator, or second conjunct -- at the point where the preceding clause is already grammatically complete without it; the same function word (because/after/from/around/and) with no complete clause before it, e.g. fronted or in a scrambled fragment, stays weak. It is retrospective over the 1-4 preceding tokens, not a predictor of a specific next token: the Jacobian lens is flat (kurtosis 3.2, incoherent guess/failed/wrong list matching nothing after the peaks), and scrambling only the left context collapses the peak.

After a short coffee break the group discussed warehouse lighting upgrades parking permits visitor badges holiday rotas and the new telephone system with lengthy debate about vendors contracts and installation dates. Members debated travel budgets conference attendance software licenses and overtime rules before returning to the delayed shipment of compressors pumps valves and gauges needed for the spring overhaul. The treasurer summarized cash flow reserves loans and payments due to suppliers while logistics outlined alternate routes backup carriers and temporary storage options near the harbor. Nobody objected when the chair proposed extending the session by another hour to finish the agenda and the group continued through reports on pensions insurance inspections cleaning contracts security patrols and elevator repairs. At last the committee approved the budget unanimously after months of heated debate.
